```yaml
name: Update Nix vendorHash

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          install_options: '--no-write-lock-file'

      - name: Detect changed dependency files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        id: changed
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '^(go\.mod|go\.sum|default\.nix)$'

      - name: Recompute vendorHash
        if: steps.changed.outputs.modified != ''
        run: |
          set -e
          ./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check if default.nix changed
        id: diff
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet --exit-code default.nix; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit changes to PR branch (same repo)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
            github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
            steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add default.nix
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: update vendorHash"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create PR for vendorHash update (fork or dispatch)
        if: (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
              steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true') ||
            (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
              steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true')
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: vendorhash-update-${{ github.sha }}
          base: main
          commit-message: "chore: update vendorHash"
          title: "chore: update vendorHash"
          body: |
            Automated vendorHash update triggered by ${{ github.event_name }}.
          add-paths: default.nix
          delete-branch: false
```
